build_internvl_chat_model: build an InternVLChatModel multimodal model that combines a vision encoder with a causal language model for image and video understanding
create_vision_encoder: create an InternVisionModel that processes pixel values through a transformer encoder to extract visual features
run_image_feature_extraction: run image feature extraction on pixel values through the vision model and project them into language model space
run_video_feature_extraction: run video feature extraction on frame sequences through the vision model to produce video embeddings
load_model_weights: load model weights from a checkpoint with support for stacked parameter mapping, expert sharding, and vision attention dummy head padding
